summary: Since 2.10, meta/requirements.yml can list role dependencies in requirements.yml format, which you can then import or include in tasks.
questions: What is meta/requirements.yml in a role for?
How do I declare role dependencies without auto-running them?

answer_card.title: Dependencies via meta/requirements.yml
answer_card.answer_md: Since Ansible 2.10 you can create `meta/requirements.yml` in a role, using the same format as a top-level `requirements.yml`. Those roles get installed, and you then import or include them in your tasks yourself.
